Application Data.NAME: SecureTech Solutions, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: SecureTech Solutions, Inc. specializes in the installation, maintenance, and monitoring of advanced alarm systems for residential and commercial properties. Our team of certified technicians ensures the highest standards of service and security, offering customized solutions that include burglar alarms, fire alarms, and integrated security systems. We also provide ongoing support and system upgrades to meet evolving security needs.
